entries.subject: DAMIT 5835: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5835.txt. Model 5835, version 2019-10-23, pole (269°, 87°), period 46.22 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 4.839 ±0.167 km. The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.,Quoted ±0.167 km is the catalog fit error; approximately 20% additional systematic diameter uncertainty applies.,Slow spin can leave the thermal observations sensitive to viewing aspect and incomplete rotation coverage; the diameter is an approximate global display scale.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The Shape lens uses cssEarth's existing shared grid to identify unavailable imagery.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT matches
entries.finding: The current DAMIT metadata export lists only selected model 5835 for this target; no other DAMIT shape is available in this listing to adopt. The imported 'included' status did not mean a second model was rendered. This check says nothing about unexamined archives.
entries.revisitWhen: The target obtains another DAMIT release or a concrete model is identified in a different archive.
